svg.title: Cattle
svg.desc: Standing Holstein cow with black-and-white coat patches, bovine muzzle, small horns, udder, long tail, and cloven hooves. Biological basis: Cattle research addresses ruminant physiology, immunology, infectious disease, genetics, reproduction, nutrition, and agricultural health.
